subject: Grygum
fact: Gru Manga's roar filled the cavern, an enraged bellow directed straight at Grygum, convinced he was the source of his pain.
source_quote: Gru Manga's roar fills the cavern, an enraged bellow directed straight at me, convinced I am the source of his pain

subject: Grygum
fact: A Derro burst from Zalthir's darkness, its hook sphere striking Grygum and knocking him prone.
source_quote: a Derro bursts from Zalthir's darkness, its hook sphere striking me. The hit throws me off balance and I am knocked prone

subject: Grygum
fact: The impact shattered Grygum's concentration, and the acidic mist he'd conjured dissipated.
source_quote: the impact shatters my concentration, and the acidic mist I'd conjured dissipates

subject: Zalthir

source_quote: I activate my Eldritch Maul, transforming my hands into a writhing mass of tentacles that extends a terrifying fifteen feet

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir moved his sphere of darkness, enveloping Gru Manga once more, depriving him of sight.
source_quote: I move the sphere of darkness, enveloping Gru Manga once more, depriving him of sight

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir's tentacles lashed out, striking the Ettin and grappling him.
source_quote: my tentacles lash out, striking the Ettin. I press the assault... my tentacles wrap around him, and Gru Manga is grappled, held tight in my grasp

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast Magic Missile, with two bolts striking a weaker Derro northeast of Grygum and the third hitting a stronger one.
source_quote: I call upon the simplest, yet most reliable, of my spells: Magic Missile. Two bolts streak towards the weaker Derro northeast of Grygum, and the third unerringly finds its mark on a stronger one

subject: Daz
fact: The weaker Derro crumpled, dead instantly.
source_quote: The weaker Derro crumples, dead instantly

subject: Daz
fact: Narrak's voice boomed, 'fools, your sacrifice is but a step toward glory!'
source_quote: Narrak's voice, strangely cutting out, booms, 'fools, your sacrifice is but a step toward glory!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pulled himself up, shedding the prone condition with a determined heave.
source_quote: I pull myself up, shedding the prone condition with a determined heave

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum unleashed a stream of corrosive acid, spraying all three Derro.
source_quote: I unleash a stream of corrosive acid, spraying all three Derro

subject: Grygum
fact: One Derro did not dodge the acid and now suffers at the start of its turns.
source_quote: Two manage to dodge its full effect, but one does not and now suffers at the start of its turns

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir delivered the final, decisive blow to Gru Manga, who fell to the ground.
source_quote: I deliver the final, decisive blow. Gru Manga falls to the ground

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir struck another Derro with an efficient strike, and it died.
source_quote: My gaze then sweeps to another Derro, and with another efficient strike it diesl

subject: Daz
fact: Narrak attacked Grygum while restrained by Daz's Maximilian's Earthen Grasp.
source_quote: Narrak, the foolish cultist of this twisted scene, attacks Grygum, although still restrained by my Maximilian's Earthen Grasp

subject: Daz
fact: Daz commanded the earthen hand to squeeze Narrak further.
source_quote: I command the earthen hand to squeeze him further

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum cast True Strike, honing his aim for the next blow.
source_quote: I focus my intent, casting True Strike, honing my aim for the next blow

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum brought his mace down on a Derro, which was still standing.
source_quote: I bring my mace down on a Derro, but it is still standing

subject: Zalthir
fact: Thorin made the final, grim decision to kill Narrak.
source_quote: Thorin makes the final, grim decision to kill Narrak

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak's last words were a desperate plea: 'No, the ritual cannot be undone!'
source_quote: his last words a desperate plea: 'No, the ritual cannot be undone!'

subject: Zalthir
fact: The 'silent spell' from earlier dissipates, and the true scope of the ritual involving the two-headed stone giant statue presents itself.
source_quote: The 'silent spell' from earlier dissipates, and the true scope of this strange ritual, involving the two-headed stone giant statue, now presents itself

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir prefers discretion and the avoidance of unnecessary conflict.
source_quote: While I prefer discretion and the avoidance of unnecessary conflict

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir considers the group's efficiency in battle undeniable.
source_quote: the efficiency of our group in battle is undeniable

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir ponders the true nature of Narrak's work: the statue, the 'Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast,' and the madness it induces in stone giants.
source_quote: My thoughts, usually calm, ponder the true nature of Narrak's work: the statue, the 'Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast,' and the madness it induces in stone giants

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir acquires peculiar, potentially useful items from Narrak's person and chest, including gold, Keoghtom's Ointment, and strange texts.
source_quote: We acquire some peculiar, yet potentially useful, items from Narrak's person and his chest, including gold, Keoghtom's Ointment, and strange texts

subject: The four factions
fact: Four different factions sent the group into the caves looking for evidence to bury the other, and this evidence can bury the entire city in blood if released.
source_quote: Four different factions sent us into these caves looking for evidence to bury the other. This evidence can bury this entire city in blood if we release it.

subject: The evidence
fact: The group has evidence that the king has been working with assassins to kill Eldeth’s clan.
source_quote: We have the evidence that the king has been working with assassins to kill Eldeth’s clan

subject: The evidence
fact: The group has an egg that would help the Keepers of the Flame or the Red Dragon.
source_quote: an egg that would help the Keepers of the Flame or the Red Dragon

subject: The evidence
fact: The group has proof of the Derro perfidity and support for Demogorgon.
source_quote: proof of the Derro perfidity and support for Demogorgon

subject: Daz
fact: Daz examined the two-foot-tall statue that turned one of Hargaam’s giants mad.
source_quote: I examine the two-foot-tall statue that is the ritual that turned one of Hargaam’s giants mad

subject: Daz
fact: Daz found a 'bunch of texts,' including 'The Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast,' confirming Narrak's role as orchestrator.
source_quote: I find a 'bunch of texts,' including 'The Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast,' which Narrak was reading. This confirms his role as the orchestrator.

subject: JimJar
fact: JimJar observed that the group has evidence they can keep and wants to make a bet it would be helpful later.
source_quote: the curious JimJar speaks. He observes that we have this evidence that we can keep. He wants to make a bet that it would be helpful to us later.

subject: JimJar
fact: JimJar advised the group to 'hold onto these' for later usefulness.
source_quote: Jimjar's advice to 'hold onto these' for later usefulness is wise, as always.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz laughed at the idea of installing democracy, noting the Duergar's innate invisibility prevents civil debate.
source_quote: The idea of 'installing democracy' is floated, but I laugh. The Duergar and their innate invisibility create a level of paranoia that prevents any kind of civil debate.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool asked Grygum and Zalthir if they could go save Rump-a-dump now.
source_quote: Hey, Zalthir? Grygum? Can we go save Rump-a-dump now? PLEASE!!!!!
